name: northstar-browser
description: Northstar web browser, Open Source License: GPL v3. Northstar web browser is a real web browser, not based on Firefox or Chrome.
readme_summary: Northstar is a minimalist, independent web browser written in C, designed for Linux, macOS, and Windows. It aims for modern web standards compatibility without relying on existing browser engines like Gecko or WebKit, focusing on security and a lean architecture.
key_features: Independent browser engine (not based on Gecko, WebKit, Blink)
Targets practical HTML5, modern CSS, and JavaScript
Primary platform: Linux, with macOS and Windows support
Security features: Landlock sandbox, seccomp, no JIT
Minimalist architecture: one page per window, one process
Web standards compliance measured against specifications
Supports audio (MP3, Opus, Vorbis), images (PNG, GIF, JPEG, WebP, AVIF), and SVG
Features: Custom elements, Workers, IndexedDB, localStorage, Cache API, WebSockets, Service Workers, WebExtensions
Networking: HTTP/2, HTTPS-first, HSTS, optional DoH, CSP, SRI
Uses QuickJS for JavaScript and lexbor for HTML parsing
primary_use_case: A lightweight, secure, and standards-compliant web browser built from scratch.
cover_image_prompt: A lone, sturdy lighthouse (representing Northstar Browser) standing on a rocky shore, its powerful beam cutting through a foggy sea. The beam illuminates a clear path through the fog, revealing a vibrant, detailed coastline with diverse structures (representing websites). Subtle digital particles and faint lines of code emanate from the lighthouse's base, connecting it to the digital sea. The overall mood is one of clarity, security, and independent navigation through the complex web. The style should be a 3D isometric illustration with a clean, focused composition and a color palette emphasizing blues, whites, and a touch of digital glow.

name: web-shot
description: Chrome extension: full-page scrolling screenshot, saved to Downloads and copied to the clipboard
readme_summary: Web Shot is a Chrome extension that captures full-page scrolling screenshots of any webpage. It stitches together multiple frames into a single PNG, automatically saves it to the Downloads folder, and copies it to the clipboard for immediate use.
key_features: Full-page scrolling screenshot
Saves to Downloads folder
Copies to clipboard
Handles sticky elements
Progress indicator on icon
Keyboard shortcut support
Multi-language interface
primary_use_case: Capturing entire webpages as a single image for easy sharing and archiving.
cover_image_prompt: A magical, enchanted scroll unfurling endlessly downwards, capturing the essence of a vibrant, detailed webpage as it's being written onto the scroll. A stylized Chrome browser icon hovers nearby, casting a beam of light that illuminates the process. Digital particles representing data flow from the webpage into the scroll. The background is a clean, minimalist digital space with subtle UI elements hinting at browser extensions. The overall mood is one of effortless capture and creation. Style: 3D isometric illustration with clean lines and a bright, inviting color palette.

name: AIPex
description: AIPex: AI browser automation assistant, no migration and privacy first. Alternative to Manus Browser Operator、 Claude Chrome and Agent Browser
readme_summary: AIPex is an open-source browser extension that enables AI-powered automation directly within your existing browser. It prioritizes privacy by keeping data local and offers a seamless integration without requiring new browsers or workflows.
key_features: Zero Migration: Operates within your current browser.
Open Source: MIT licensed for transparency and extensibility.
Privacy First: Local data processing and Bring Your Own Key (BYOK).
Agent Ready: Supports MCP, skills, and browser-cli within the same runtime.
Fast Performance: Utilizes local daemon, DOM snapshots, and stable element UIDs for efficient automation.
Low Overhead: Reduces token and latency costs compared to image-based automation.
primary_use_case: To provide a privacy-first, open-source, and efficient AI-powered browser automation solution that integrates seamlessly into a user's existing browsing environment.
cover_image_prompt: A friendly, anthropomorphic browser window character with a subtle AI glow, holding a set of digital keys and a magnifying glass. The browser character is effortlessly organizing and manipulating floating digital elements representing web pages, tabs, and data streams. In the background, a small, stylized lock icon signifies privacy, and faint lines of code or data particles subtly connect the browser to a user's desktop. The scene should convey ease of use and powerful, localized control. The art style should be a clean, 3D isometric illustration with a bright, approachable color palette, emphasizing clarity and innovation.

name: docker-steam-headless
description: A Headless Steam Docker image supporting NVIDIA GPU and accessible via Web UI
readme_summary: This repository provides a Docker image for a headless Steam service, enabling remote game streaming. It supports NVIDIA GPU acceleration, web-based access via noVNC, and compatibility with Steam Link and Moonlight.
key_features: Steam Client configured for running on Linux with Proton
Moonlight compatible server for easy remote desktop streaming
Easy installation of EmeDeck, Heroic and Lutris via Flatpak
Full video/audio noVNC web access to a Xfce4 Desktop
NVIDIA, AMD and Intel GPU support
Full controller support
Support for Flatpak and Appimage installation
Root access
Based on Debian Trixie
primary_use_case: To deploy a headless Steam instance in a Docker container for remote game streaming and access.
cover_image_prompt: A cozy living room scene where a person is relaxing on a couch, holding a game controller. Instead of a traditional TV, a holographic projection emanates from a small, sleek black box (representing the Docker container) displaying a vibrant, action-packed video game. Subtle digital streams of light flow from the box to the controller, symbolizing the remote connection. In the background, a faint outline of a computer monitor shows lines of code and the 'docker-steam-headless' logo. The overall mood is one of effortless entertainment and accessibility, with a clean, modern aesthetic and soft, inviting lighting. The style should be a 3D isometric illustration with a focus on clear visual storytelling.
